name: Platinum Vape | 1g 510 Live Resin | Cherry Zlushie
description:
Sweet, tart, and ice-cold smooth. Cherry Zlushie is a flavor-packed hybrid that blends juicy cherry notes with a frosty, candy-like finish. Extracted with live resin, this cart keeps every terpene intact for bold flavor and balanced effects. Expect an uplifting head buzz paired with mellow body relaxation—a perfect anytime hybrid that keeps the vibes light, happy, and chill.

Strain Type: Hybrid

Flavor Notes: Juicy cherry, sweet candy, frosty smooth

Effects: Balanced, euphoric, relaxing yet uplifting
